summary: Add a transverse-wave diagram and make the intermediate-filter effect explicit in the lesson.

improvements.where: note, after the first paragraph of ## Key ideas
improvements.why: The figure gate identifies an undrawn wave concept for outcomes 9702-7.5.1 and 9702-7.5.2; a labelled transverse wave makes the vibration direction relative to propagation visible.
improvements.what: Request and embed one `wave` diagram showing a transverse displacement wave, with propagation along the horizontal axis and vibration perpendicular to it. Explain in the note that the profile represents one selected plane of vibration; do not imply that the two-dimensional plot itself depicts every possible polarisation direction.

improvements.where: note, after ## Method or in ## Traps
improvements.why: Misconception m4 and CAIE 9702 Nov 2023 P12 Q24 address a crossed-filter result that the note does not work through.
improvements.what: Add a brief calculation for initially crossed axes with a middle axis at $45^\circ$: the middle filter transmits $I_0\cos^2 45^\circ=I_0/2$ and the final one transmits $I_0/4$. State that each filter sets the incident polarisation for the next filter.
